green_summary.PlatformInfra.v1: tools/infra/platform.mjs validate|probe — no up subcommand (I06 is read-only verification; platform policy writes belong to existing P tasks + Comet closeout). Exit contract 0=PASS / 1=input-or-prerequisite / 2=verification-failure (execution-contract.json V_INFRA_I06.cli_contract), fail-closed loads, displayPath/redactHostPaths on structured output, no host paths in receipts. validate checks all five domain files: PlatformInfra.v1/Environment.v1 interfaces, project binding to infra/delivery/registry.json, same-origin identity (repoId 1285806550 / principalId 262266039 / owner ql-wade referenced from I01, never re-registered), honest UNVERIFIED readback (invalid gh token + TLS x509 OSStatus -26276 recorded verbatim), protection-claim guard (configuredStatus must stay UNVERIFIED/NOT_CONFIGURED — CONFIGURED is PLATFORM_PROTECTION_CLAIM_FORBIDDEN), remotePolicyWrites.allowed must be false, required-check names forbidden without REGISTERED status, four blocking semantics + failClosed, example files must declare example=true, Environment.v1 rollback/readback gates, retention fail-closed rules, credentialRef format + project namespace, secret-value/host-path scans; catalog membership gaps reported as explicit catalogGaps (I01-owned, validate stays exit 0 — outline/code-knowledge precedent). Probes are real: repository-identity performs one actual read-only gh api call (honest UNVERIFIED with the raw TLS error; local same-origin consistency checked locally), required-checks-authorization refuses remote policy writes with the plan-rule basis and reports per-ref credential tiers (every ref explicitly refused or UNRESOLVED, never a value).
green_summary.IntegrationIdentity.v1: registry-environment-identity probe evaluates the full chain from a --chain fixture (LOCAL_ONLY mechanism proof): PR head -> mergeSHA -> build artifact digest -> deployment identity -> readback. Exact-SHA check binding with four blocking semantics (CHECK_MISSING / CHECK_SKIPPED / CHECK_TIMED_OUT / CHECK_STALE_EVIDENCE), TAG_DIGEST_DRIFT + ARTIFACT_NOT_FROM_MERGE on the artifact, ENVIRONMENT_PROJECT_MISMATCH + DEPLOYMENT_DIGEST_MISMATCH + RECEIPT_CORRELATION_MISSING on deployment, QUERY_BY_CORRELATION_ID recovery for lost responses (READBACK_CORRELATION_MISMATCH / READBACK_UNCONFIRMED), rollback gate (ROLLBACK_NOT_APPROVED / ROLLBACK_RETENTION_MISSING / ROLLBACK_DIGEST_MISMATCH / ROLLBACK_TERMINAL_STATE_UNCONFIRMED). Input-format errors (bad SHA/digest, unparseable fixture) exit 1, semantic blocks exit 2 — strictly separated. Bare invocation (no fixture) is structured UNVERIFIED with requiredInputs + plannedSteps, executed=false, no skip:true, and never claims the real platform (real merge-gate/environment readback stay with P4_1/P4_2). Green chain and green rollback exit 0 with scope=LOCAL_ONLY.
green_summary.Environment.v1 + artifact-retention: environment-registration.example.json carries the Environment.v1 contract shape: UNSELECTED endpoint/owner (unprovided input — nothing invented), networkIsolation with cross-project rule, deploy/rollback credentialRefs, rollback fail-closed (approvalRequired + sameDigestRequired + retainLastApprovedArtifact + independentBusinessTerminalStateRequired), readbackOracle with correlationIdRequired and the timeout rule (query by original correlation ID, confirmation requires the independent business terminal state). artifact-retention.json: rpo/rto/retentionPeriod/encryptionOwner/destructionPrecondition all UNVERIFIED with autoCleanupEnabled=false (AUTO_CLEANUP_WITHOUT_CONFIRMED_RECOVERY if flipped), manifest preservation of exact source/policy/artifact manifests and protected-check history, rollbackRetention rules (old evidence never authorizes a new SHA; revocation forces re-verification because a backup cannot restore revoked capabilities).
